defensiveCodeReview.scope: All uncommitted M0–M2 implementation and lifecycle changes relative to c2c7f67; generated schema reviewed through its source and generation gate. Existing user edits preserved; no commit, push, real credential or account use.
reproducedBeforeCleanup: A valid HTTPS calendar URL over 2048 characters was rejected as if the scheme or credential placement were invalid.
A 300-character identifier was silently omitted by the FTS declaration index despite fitting its total source and row budgets.
A malformed CalDAV calendar collection was silently discarded, allowing a partial read to appear complete.
An OAuth refresh requested at the same time as a config edit caused another unnecessary reconnect at the next boundary.
Deleting a selected tracked Chinese-named file was refused because Git's human-readable quoted path was compared with the literal filename.

decisions.area: Connector settings, credential references and forms
decisions.removed: Undocumented URL, email username, sender, recipient-count, recipient-length and env-name length caps; the extra browser URL maxlength; re-sanitizing the Runtime's already redacted settings response and repeating native form/server validation in the submit handler.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Reject unknown/invalid JSON and unreadable existing files rather than overwrite other sections; validate exactly the selected section and whole final configuration; atomic replace and serialized settings saves prevent partial writes and lost updates. HTTPS/no embedded URL credentials, query or fragment; paired calendar account/pointer; documented vault-name grammar, env-name grammar, mail hostname/port, TLS or STARTTLS, nonempty username/recipient and recipient list for live sending are actual configuration/transport/authority boundaries. Backend redacts legacy raw references; UI uses the redacted null/empty field and requires correction. Vault suggestions still check the legacy index data; browser native validation gives immediate input feedback while the engine is authoritative.

decisions.area: Approval, mail, Feishu and credential storage
decisions.removed: Re-reading the already validated Feishu identity and falling back to app identity after approval.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Turn-scoped exact approval, account/destination/content digest, expiry rejection, durable grant creation before effect, atomic initial revocation of once grants and compare-and-set consumption prevent cross-turn, stale and double authorization. Allowlist, draft-by-default, human confirmation, read-back/receipt states and no retry for uncertain delivery preserve the external-effect contract. Explicit IMAP Ring provider and certificate/hostname validation prevent the reproduced TLS initialization panic without a global setting or plaintext fallback. Actual env/keychain/file/memory location is used; unresolved reference is not presented as a confirmed keychain credential.

decisions.area: OAuth, capability cards and dynamic MCP lists
decisions.removed: Shadow copy of current tool names, unconsumed refresh flag on simultaneous config change, silent poisoned-ready-slot fallback, raw prefix scheme test, invented preparing status after refreshing the card.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Configured target and supported identity only; parsed HTTPS endpoint/no userinfo, provider state match, bound callback before URL publication, one in-flight flow, bounded preparation and sign-in, no-store, no raw provider error/token in the web response. URL checks at the browser navigation boundary and generic error messages prevent unsafe navigation and accidental credential display. Explicit 403 insufficient_scope response is required for MissingScope. Unknown/unavailable state remains honest. Serialize table refresh, keep original base names, consume one invalidation per reconnect and retain immutable in-flight handlers; listChanged allows a listing to become empty, while temporary listing failure warns and retains the previous snapshot.

decisions.area: Calendar parsing/discovery and read-only connector waits
decisions.removed: Repeat secret resolution for each discovered collection, redundant trusted-target recheck after the validated root/resolve path, duplicate href character check and impossible Unicode-scalar error branch; swallowed malformed collection error; duplicate unsupported/already-received poll checks; internal calendar tool JSON encode/decode and 200-display-row limit.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: One credential snapshot per read; trusted configured origin or documented iCloud shard only, explicit redirect bound, HTTPS and no embedded credentials, query or fragment. External XML/ICS, individual DAV status, scalar/entity decoding, malformed syntax and response byte/collection/time caps prevent false empty/partial results and unbounded network reads. Only the declared email/new-unread and calendar/upcoming-15m types are admitted; one minute interval and two concurrent polls; EXAMINE/UID metadata only, UIDVALIDITY/UIDNEXT and numeric UID filtering, durable immutable account/generation baseline, upcoming timed event filter, task-control lock and suspension recheck, idempotent signal. Changed account, network/read error or stale task retains the wait, never invents input or widens authority.

decisions.removed: Redundant stat/exists/is-file checks after symlink_metadata, duplicated path-list validation, optional run-id fallback after the caller already has a run; display-quoted rather than literal tracked-file comparison.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Explicit confirmation, inactive task for manual/policy controls, expected linked worktree/canonical root/branch, literal normal relative files only, no metadata paths, symlinks or directories, regular file or exact tracked deletion; only opted-in policy may name future files. Path count and length bound Git subprocess work and argv; no existing staged changes, hooks, clean filters, fsmonitor, signing prompts or alternate Git state. Only approved paths staged/committed; unchanged boundary reuses HEAD, policy rechecked under task-control lock, exact durable boundary mapping deduplicated, failures stop execution for review. A recorded commit whose event fails is reported, not replayed or hidden.

decisions.area: Timeline, control API and UI asynchronous state
decisions.removed: Unreachable response-task-id mismatch branches for the same typed request/response, repeated optional-action existence checks inside wrappers that are only created when the action exists, duplicate eligibility check in checkpoint submit, silent failed-run event lookup error.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Durable ordering/cursors and latest-versus-next detection at the store's 500-row page cap; task events are secondary to settled runs, with failures surfaced in stderr. Serial catch-up with an additional pass handles concurrent refresh and checkpoint events; current task-id comparison discards stale async responses, busy/confirmation state prevents duplicate human submissions. Known event vocabulary localization and own-key checks preserve unknown historical evidence without inherited object fields. Typed HTTP handlers relay human-only methods and do not duplicate engine authority.

decisions.area: Read-only code navigation and search evidence
decisions.removed: Undocumented 256-byte identifier cap and duplicated grep file/preview constants; building an index for a query that cannot match the declaration grammar.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Best-effort declaration parser, skip unsupported/unreadable/oversize files and symlinks, existing 20,000-entry walk, per-file/preview and output caps, 32 MiB source/30,000-row index budgets; quoted FTS MATCH plus exact equality and valid symbol grammar keep bounded exact lookup. Search leads live in their own manifest and are never fetched claim evidence; canonical primary URLs and at-most-ten archives bound results. Archive write failure warns but does not discard useful search results; model tool errors remain text.

decisions.area: Dashboard process lifecycle and fixture harnesses
decisions.removed: Duplicate stop publication and redundant async shutdown of already-flushed owned stdin pipe; separate ignored start_kill/wait results replaced with one bounded kill/reap and explicit errors; no claim of successful forced stop when it is only requested.
decisions.retainedAndWhy: Typed 60-second startup readiness before listener/gateway, short early-exit cleanup, post-probe death check, shared stop/EOF watch retained for late subscribers, pending request RAII and closing-pipe race check; persistent streams and abandoned forwarding end on stop/client disconnect. Unix process groups protect graceful terminal Ctrl-C; concurrent 25-second engine and 3-second HTTP/gateway drains plus 2-second forced-stop bound prevent indefinite wait and stale ownership. Fixture retries, deadlines and targeted cleanup exist to bound real isolated process/browser/loopback tests; no actual user Runtime restart.
